title: 국군수송사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of Commander and Other Officials)
(1) The Commander shall, under the direction of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and command and supervise units assigned or attached thereto. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2010>
(2) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and perform the Commander's duties on an acting basis where the Commander is unable to perform them due to unavoidable circumstances.
